cards.text: Amos, one of the sheep breeders of Tekoa, has been bringing the LORD's word to Israel (Amos 1:1). Now he calls out to some women living on Mount Samaria, and he calls them cows of Bashan. Friend, if somebody opened a conversation with ME like that, I'd climb right back into the junk drawer.

cards.question: Amos says these women on Mount Samaria oppress the poor and crush the ___.

cards.text: And they tell their husbands, "Bring us more to drink." Then the Lord GOD swears an oath, and He swears it by His holiness.

cards.question: The Lord GOD swears by His holiness about these women of Samaria. What does He say is coming for them?

answers.text: They will be taken away with hooks
They will be crowned in Samaria
They will be given more land

cards.text: Hooks for them, and fishhooks for their posterity. Friend, I sat in the back of a junk drawer for years, and I'd take that drawer over a fishhook ANY day.

cards.question: When these women are taken away, the LORD says they will walk out through the city's strong, unbroken walls.

cards.text: Out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, cast out toward Harmon. Then the LORD turns to Israel's worship, and He names two places: Bethel and Gilgal.

cards.question: The LORD sends Israel to Bethel and to Gilgal. What does He say they'll do there?

answers.text: Repent and turn back to Him

cards.text: And He keeps going: "Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days." EVERY THREE DAYS, friend, and I can't even remember to dust my gold base that often.

cards.question: Along with leavened bread as a thank offering, the LORD tells Israel to keep their freewill offerings quiet.
All those sacrifices, tithes and loud offerings. Why does the LORD say the children of Israel keep it all going?

answers.text: It's what they love to do

cards.text: Now the LORD pulls out a list of what He already sent Israel's way, and friend, it is a LONG list. First up: cleanness of teeth in all their cities and lack of bread in all their towns.

cards.question: Even with lack of bread in all their towns, Israel still did not ___ to the LORD.

cards.text: Keep your ears on that line, yet you did not return to Me, because it keeps coming back. Next, the LORD held back the rain when the harvest was three months away.

cards.question: When the LORD held back the rain from Israel, He held it back from every city and every field alike.

cards.text: One field got rain, and another withered without it. People staggered from city to city for water to drink and STILL weren't satisfied, which is me with my phone at 2 percent, wandering every room hunting for a charger.
There it is AGAIN, friend: yet you did not return to Me. Next on the list, the LORD struck their growing gardens and vineyards with blight and mildew.

cards.question: Blight and mildew hit Israel's gardens and vineyards. What devoured their fig and olive trees?

cards.text: Yet you did not return to Me, AGAIN. And friend, it gets heavier: the LORD sent plagues among them like those of Egypt, and He killed their young men with the sword, along with their captured horses.

cards.question: Plagues and the sword came on Israel. What does the LORD say He filled their nostrils with?

cards.text: And STILL, friend: yet you did not return to Me. Now the LORD brings up two cities He once overthrew.

cards.question: The LORD says He overthrew some of Israel the same way He overthrew which two cities?
The LORD tells Israel they were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze. What does that picture show?

cards.text: Five times now: yet you did not return to Me, and friend, when MY oven timer goes off five times, even I come running. Eventually.

cards.question: The LORD says that is what He will do to Israel. Then what does He tell Israel to do?

cards.text: Then the words turn to who this God is. He forms the mountains and He creates the wind, and friend, here I am doing a happy dance on my gold base when a whole batch comes out the same size.

cards.question: The God who forms the mountains and creates the wind keeps His thoughts hidden from people.
The One who forms the mountains and creates the wind has a name. What is it?

answers.text: The LORD the God of Hosts

cards.text: He turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth. And THAT, friend, is the God Israel is told to prepare to meet.
